baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from the hand bound to the neck through total extension to sitting blamed and exhausted.
baseline_models.mechanism: The hand combines controlled resources with the capacity to transfer them. Binding blocks deployment, while total release consumes the reserve; the causal result converts a one-time quantity choice into loss of future agency.

activation_trace.role: The owning and disposing hand supplies both the resources under control and the agency that deploys them.
A restraint fixed around an organ makes withholding an active disabling of the means of transfer.
Releasing and extending the hand supplies the opposite pole: capacity is put fully into circulation.
Total enclosure of all parts removes any remainder and turns generosity into exhaustive deployment.
Inability to rise renders the result as disabled future action rather than neutral sitting.
Deserved reproach adds a social audit to the material failure.
Spent strength and exhausted stock identify the terminal state produced by release without reserve.

changed_reading.before: A warning to be neither stingy nor extravagant.
changed_reading.after: A design for preserving actionable capacity: resources must circulate, but no transfer may consume the ability to answer the next claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reflexive body picture of your hand, your neck, full extension, and the actor left sitting exposed to blame.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse stages two bodily postures that feed back upon their agent. Self-binding contracts the field of relation; indiscriminate extension removes cover and motion, so the body that tried to reach without limit becomes static, vulnerable, and publicly answerable.

activation_trace.role: The beneficent hand makes outward relation and favor the bodily capacity at stake.
The collaring restraint literalizes a posture in which the actor binds outward beneficence back onto the self.
The neck as the body part receiving the restraint closes the withholding posture into a self-directed loop.
Spreading against contraction supplies a body opened without boundary.
Fixed sitting is the bodily reversal of the prior attempt at unlimited reach.
Being bare of protection makes depletion also an exposure, not merely an empty balance.

changed_reading.before: The verse judges two spending totals.
changed_reading.after: The verse diagnoses how repeated postures remake the actor: closure constricts relation, while boundaryless exposure returns as immobility and loss of protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding commands distinguish a material channel from enduring relational channels. Care is enacted through beneficence, a lowered protective side, mercy, and accessible speech; therefore a hand unable to transfer at one moment need not become a person closed to the claimant.

activation_trace.role: The restrained organ anchors the revised question: whether material limitation has become relational closure.
Beneficent action makes care an enacted obligation rather than a feeling measured only by expenditure.
The wing as side, hand, and shelter supplies a second bodily instrument for protective relation.
Gentle pliancy without humiliation defines a non-dominating posture between hard refusal and self-erasure.
Tender mercy supplies the motive that keeps care active when material action is bounded.
Turning one's side away names a temporary failure of the material channel that could harden into withdrawal.
Spoken address keeps the claimant within relation when the hand cannot presently give.
Ease after difficulty makes gracious speech a bridge through constrained circumstances.

structural_cues: 17:23-24 choreograph care through speech and a lowered body before 17:29 choreographs the hand.
17:28 immediately precedes the focus and supplies easy speech when material response is deferred.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies embodied care, a turned-away material posture, and compensating speech; I infer that inability and withholding are separated by whether relation remains open. A live alternative is that 17:28 teaches courtesy independently of the focus verse's resource limit.

changed_reading.before: A closed hand and an empty hand are opposite financial errors.
changed_reading.after: Material inability is not itself the bound-hand error; the error becomes closure when mercy, acknowledgment, and speech are also withdrawn.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence orders circulation before restraint: transfer what is due to named claimants, then prevent wealth from being scattered beyond purpose. Reserve is legitimate only after rights have been recognized; anti-waste cannot be used to rename nonpayment as prudence.

activation_trace.role: The hand of direct transfer anchors the focus in an actual movement from holder to recipient.
Concrete giving establishes positive release as the first operation, not a concession after saving.
A right owned by its claimant converts some outgoing wealth from optional generosity into discharge of another's due.
Money dispersed in excess supplies the distinct failure that consumes capacity after rightful transfer is secured.

structural_cues: 17:26 places affirmative giving and a claimant's right before the paired prohibition on dispersal.
17:27 intensifies the warning against dispersal before 17:29 restates the two-ended hand discipline.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies giving, an owned right, and waste as dispersal; I infer an ordering rule: satisfy claims, then preserve capacity. The live alternative is a less ordered, general warning against both stinginess and extravagance.

changed_reading.before: Moderation means choosing a middle amount that protects the giver.
changed_reading.after: Moderation is fiduciary sequencing: release what belongs to claimants, but do not scatter the remainder so completely that future claims become impossible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate repetition of extension in relation to provision, paired with measured constriction, replaces a fixed midpoint with responsive calibration. The permitted span changes with actual allotment; the invariant is preservation of responsible agency.

activation_trace.role: Full breadth and increase anchor the dangerous human attempt to turn current capacity into total outflow.
Expansion of provision relocates breadth within a variable supply rather than an autonomous human maximum.
An allotted gift supplies the changing resource envelope within which the hand acts.
Constriction to a small measure supplies the counter-cycle that any sustainable practice must survive.

structural_cues: 17:30 immediately repeats ب س ط after the focus, now with provision as its object.
Expansion and constriction are coordinated in one clause rather than assigned fixed moral values.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies variable expansion, allotted provision, and constriction; I infer that human restraint should track changing capacity rather than enforce a constant numerical midpoint. A live alternative is that 17:30 explains unequal means without prescribing a method of calibration.

changed_reading.before: The safe choice is always the same moderate fraction.
changed_reading.after: The safe rule is dynamic: release can widen or narrow with provision, but it must never become either permanent paralysis or exhaustive outflow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next prohibition exposes fear as a dangerous controller of allocation. Anticipated empty-handedness can drive a holder to erase future claimants; the focus therefore regulates not only amounts but the panic loop by which fear of depletion produces destructive closure.

activation_trace.role: The self-imposed restraint anchors the defensive closure that scarcity fear can harden.
Fear mixed with awe supplies the anticipatory pressure acting before the feared shortage is present.
A hand stripped of money until need gives the fear a direct empty-hand image contiguous with the focus.
Taking life marks the terminal social consequence when allocation panic decides which claimant may remain.
Allotted provision interrupts the assumption that the fearful holder is the sole source of every future share.

structural_cues: 17:31 follows the focus and names fear of destitution as a motive for eliminating dependents.
The provision statement answers the fear between the prohibition and its judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fear, the image of a hand emptied of wealth, killing, and provision; I infer that fear of depletion can turn reserve into life-denying closure. The live alternative is the narrower reading of 17:31 as a direct ban without feedback into 17:29.

changed_reading.before: The bound hand is simply a miserly preference.
changed_reading.after: The bound hand can be a panic response: imagined scarcity monopolizes control, hardens against dependents, and must be interrupted by a wider account of provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later case grants real authority for a recognized wrong and immediately bars excess. This activates the hand as power: legitimate capacity must not be chained into impotence, but possessing warrant never licenses its total release.

activation_trace.role: The hand as effective authority opens the focus beyond money to power capable of enforcement.
An unleashed hand capable of taking, striking, or giving supplies the operational form of authority.
A specific rightful claim establishes that restraint does not cancel legitimate action.
Granted power and jurisdiction supply an authorized hand rather than merely private appetite.
Crossing the limit places an internal boundary inside the exercise of otherwise valid authority.

structural_cues: 17:33 grants authority and then immediately commands that it not cross the limit.
The verse also repeats ج ع ل from the focus, linking the construction of a hand posture with the construction of a legal power.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rightful claim, granted authority, and an explicit no-excess boundary; I project that same architecture onto the focus hand's power branch. The live alternative is that the hand remains exclusively financial and the legal case is only analogous.

changed_reading.before: The hand is a purse whose only variable is how much it spends.
changed_reading.after: The hand is also delegated power: disabling it abandons warranted action, while releasing it without an internal limit converts authority into excess.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protected property, a maturation horizon, completed covenants, full measure, and a straight balance turn the hand from an absolute owner into an accountable steward. Neither closure nor total release is judged by the holder's feeling alone; both are tested against preservation, timing, and auditable proportion.

activation_trace.role: The possessing hand anchors the assumption that control is real while leaving its moral title open to revision.
Property held and accumulated supplies the asset whose control need not equal beneficial ownership.
A child cut off from a protector supplies the vulnerable claimant for whom another hand must preserve capacity.
Completion without deficiency requires the steward to deliver the whole obligation rather than a self-chosen remainder.
Measured food supplies a concrete audit that replaces vague moderation with countable performance.
The balance of justice makes proportion answerable to an external standard rather than the holder's impulse.
Straightness and equilibrium supply the stable form that bounded circulation seeks.

structural_cues: 17:34 moves from protected property through a future maturity point to a covenant that must be completed.
17:35 follows with full measure and straight weighing, converting moral proportion into an auditable procedure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies another's protected asset, delayed transfer, completion, and just measurement; I infer that the hand may administer what it does not own absolutely. The live alternative is that these are adjacent fiduciary cases rather than a revision of the focus hand.

changed_reading.before: Your hand means your wealth, so moderation balances your generosity against your security.
changed_reading.after: What is in your hand may be entrusted capacity; restraint, release, and timing must preserve another's due and survive measurement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing verse repeats the focus's make-not, causal consequence, and blamed result while relocating the object to ultimate allegiance. Without equating financial excess with association, the frame contains personal agency: the hand is neither sovereign enough to close every claim nor limitless enough to answer every claim by itself.

activation_trace.role: Making something assume a state anchors the focus as a deliberate construction of one's own agency.
Blame supplies the shared evaluative result that the closing frame repeats.
The repeated act of assigning a state opens a structural comparison between constructed hand posture and constructed allegiance.
The worshiped object supplies the ultimate-agency boundary within which personal capacity must remain finite.
Repeated deserved reproach links the consequences without making their offenses identical.
Expulsion and removal intensify the closing consequence and expose the limit of self-constituted agency.

structural_cues: 17:29 has ولا تجعل ... فتقعد ملوما, while 17:39 has ولا تجعل ... فتلقى ... ملوما.
The repeated frame encloses the intervening commands within the passage's final statement about allegiance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated syntax, repeated making, repeated blame, and the final allegiance prohibition; I infer a shared critique of absolutized agency. The materially live alternative is purely rhetorical framing with no semantic transfer from allegiance back to the hand.

changed_reading.before: The verse is an isolated technique for managing a private resource.
changed_reading.after: The verse also disciplines creaturely agency: use real capacity without treating the hand as either an absolute gatekeeper or an inexhaustible source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because كُلَّ in the focus grammatically expresses totality, not fatigue. It remains anchored because the same supplied root inventory carries both totality and blunting, the focus ends in spent strength, and later context repeats totalizing ك ل ل around accountable faculties and acts. Downstream prose should present it only as a root-image echo, never as a lexical replacement for 'all.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The movement from كُلَّ البسط to مَّحْسُورًا.

activation_trace.role: Total inclusion gives the explicit sense of an extension with no reserved part.
Blunting and weariness add a latent shadow in which totalization already tends toward loss of edge and force.
Exhausted capacity realizes the fatigue shadow as the explicit terminal state.
All accountable faculties distribute totality across a continuing field of obligations rather than one exhaustive act.
The passage-wide all gathers the acts for judgment and reinforces the cost of monopolizing all capacity in one release.

changed_reading.before: All extension is only a numerical maximum.
changed_reading.after: As a qualified root echo, totalization carries its own fatigue: spending the whole field of capacity on one act blunts the actor needed for the rest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because 17:37 addresses bodily gait and impossible reach rather than spending. It remains anchored in the focus's fully extended hand and immobilized result, while the later verse supplies failed penetration, failed attainment, and length. Downstream prose should call it a bodily analogy about finite reach, not substitute it for the resource reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The fully extended hand that ends with the actor unable to continue.

activation_trace.role: Length, distance, and the hand's reach turn total extension into a claim about how far agency can go.
Attempted penetration through the earth supplies one impossible fantasy of bodily efficacy.
Reaching a limit supplies the explicit test that the finite body fails.
Length and extension make the mountain comparison a check on fantasies of total personal reach.

changed_reading.before: Extending the hand fully means only spending everything available.
changed_reading.after: It can also dramatize a fantasy that personal reach can be total; depletion is the body's correction of that imagined boundlessness.

strongest_changes: The preceding give-right-disperse sequence turns moderation into ordered fiduciary duty: satisfy claims before preserving reserve.
The immediate expansion-constriction pair makes moderation responsive to variable provision rather than a fixed midpoint.
Scarcity fear reveals why the bound hand can become destructive, while the authority and stewardship cases generalize the hand into bounded, auditable power.
The repeated closing frame contains personal agency under ultimate allegiance without equating resource error with association.
summary.what_was_special: Immediate root and construction recurrences convert a familiar spending maxim into a mechanism of sustainable agency: material transfer, relational continuity, legal power, entrusted property, bodily finitude, and accountability remain distinct but share the need for active capacity with an internal limit.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal result may attach grammatically only to total extension rather than equally to both prohibited postures.
The authority reading is visibly branch-backed but may need to remain secondary to the direct resource sense.
The 17:39 agency frame is a structural resonance, not an equation between spending failure and association.
The fatigue sense of ك ل ل is an exploratory root-image echo and must not be rendered as the lexical meaning of كُلَّ.
